trigger: USB report 20261007-090823: all 18 retained native roots proven; zero owned title/thumbnail matches despite successful metadata, four custom title decisions and six random-frame decodes.
selection: Resource family + singular typed semantic paths + per-instance native consumer ownership. Revision remains diagnostic/instance identity, never an admission allowlist for the two live recipes.

checks: Navigation ID valid and optional presentation ID agrees.
Title singular UTF-8 content; optional tap title agrees; no command runs; unambiguous configuration.
Each static image source belongs to the navigation ID; no composite/local/procedural input.
One matching already materialized headline/image owned by this factory component before enabling that role.
Immutable presentation-restored factory argument equals source; unique native element occurrence within the captured factory controller.
adapters.identity: Exactly one primary YTICommand extension. Resolve Direct WatchEndpoint.videoId field 1, or up to six native descriptor-proven CoWatch/InlineMutedWatchEndpointMutationCommand wrappers through YTICommand field 1. Require singular message fields and validated terminal WatchEndpoint. Preserve all flags/navigation bytes; unknown wrappers remain blocked.
adapters.candidate_policy: Candidate family is not permission. FE cards must satisfy this same complete reviewed 232954548 semantic recipe; no use of old 232903841 bundled paths solely because a basename matches.

adapters.identity: Explicit owning YTSlimVideoMetadataSectionController/YTSlimVideoInformationCellController videoID, never guessed from global playback.
checks: Matching native component model with only title restored equals immutable original.
Unique original native headline and current source/owner/generation before writes.

fingerprint: Bounded cached recipe/capability identity; not an instance permission or content hash. Each model and native role is validated again. Capture uses a separate field/wire/occurrence structural fingerprint.
projection: Copied factory input only. Restore explicitly allowed title, title-entity configuration, static image and matching accessibility fields and require byte equality with the original model; unrelated navigation, menu, tap and visibility branches remain invariant.

lifecycle.strategy: Private keyed ELMNodeController callbacks on accepted factory-owned descendants; no global ELMTextNode/ELMImageNode setElement observers.
lifecycle.retirement: Remove only private keys on new source/factory/settings generation and binding destruction; weak node/controller references.

capture.sampling: resource + surface + accepted semantic video/rejected ordinary/generic + command chain/failure + structural shape

watch_trace.activation: Explicit Start DeArrow diagnostic capture only

stages.W01: Native window touch with receiving view/ancestor/recognizer state
stages.W03: Native node tap or text-link path
stages.W04: Elements command bridge entry/return; original arguments and completion forwarded unchanged
stages.W05: Native presentation or seek requested; no inference of successful completion

limitations: New structural families need a reviewed recipe; no arbitrary protobuf search authorizes writes.
Existing legacy bundled compact/card/context recipes remain pinned.
Interactive titles need command-range remapping and remain original.
Player cover is excluded; watch metadata supports titles only.
Unknown watch owner or model layout remains original with directed checkpoints.
Opaque serialized horizontal-shelf child layouts remain unreviewed; only independently addressed generic Element children are enabled.
User reports watch controls work. Native interaction forwarding is retained; DeArrow visible replacement is not device-verified.
Home/Search InlineMuted terminal command is resolved dynamically; this build still needs a report proving consumer roles and visible replacement on each requested surface.
device_capture: Start saved USB capture, scroll ordinary Home cards, leave a card visible and open a video.
Inspect per-role primitive census, original-role matches, ancestry rejection samples, projection, native factory content, consumption and visibility.
Use chapters/comments and revisit recycled cards to inspect preserved interactions and original restoration.

children.path: Reviewed generic Element.children field 3 only, field/occurrence steps for repeated siblings
children.binding: Per-row/controller retained group, independent component path/video/request/generation; generic childElements occurrence identity under the accepted factory source. Source changes retire all old bindings.
children.projection: Compose each accepted component projection on a copy of the original row; never mutate original section entries. Shared row refresh coalesces updates.
children.opaque_shelf_models: Unsupported until reviewed native child-element contracts are captured; no arbitrary model descent.

native_ownership.input: Copied exact row factory argument; restore only allowed presentation paths and compare complete immutable source, including all accepted occurrences.
native_ownership.element: Native factory ELMElement.instance opaque identity; childElements follow reviewed generic Element.children occurrence paths. Arena lifetime retained. No data getter, C++ aggregate calls, guessed offsets or debug-text parsing.
native_ownership.controller: Register keyed native load callback before consumer-role proof; register layout when materialized controller exists. Traverse read-only materializedInstance/controller children/attached subnodes/yoga children with identity deduplication and 256-object bound. node getter only after loaded flag.
native_ownership.role: Traverse both native controller parent and owningComponent edges, resolve the exact factory occurrence, require one original headline/thumbnail match. Title and thumbnail permissions are independent. Duplicate, conflicting and over-budget matches stay blocked.
native_ownership.consumption: Owned headline equals projected title; native thumbnail decoded pixels equal decoded projected image bytes, with exact immutable factory image payload and generation/epoch guards. Encoding alone never proves visibility.

random_frame.proof: Valid owner-scoped duration; SponsorBlock exclusions; requested timestamp response match; native image decode/encode; projected factory input; decoded native consumption; actual visibility.

primitive_ancestry.start: Native node controller, or the typed component/controller itself.
primitive_ancestry.scope: Exact native ELMElement occurrence and current row/generation; independent edge traversal; reject competing accepted row occurrences, ambiguity and truncation. Stop at the proven occurrence boundary.
primitive_ancestry.materialization: Read-only existing graph. Preserve loaded-state guard; no guessed memory layout, lazy node forcing, global setter hooks or view-tree ancestry.

primitive_diagnostics.exported: Class/edge names, bounded resolved ancestry, original-role equality booleans, loaded/content presence, counts and truncation. No raw content, IDs, URLs or addresses.
primitive_diagnostics.role_adapters: ELMTextNode and ELMImageNode remain reviewed consumers. ASTextNode and expandable text candidates are observed without authorizing unreviewed title roles.
